Subject: Cascade 45L is back in stock
Preview: 45 liters, 1.4 kg — ready when your next trip is.
Body: The Cascade 45L Trekking Pack (NB-TRK-01) is restocked.

If you've been waiting on it, here's what you're working with:

• 45-liter capacity — enough for a 3–5 day trip packed with intention.
• 1,400 g (1.4 kg) — light enough that you'll notice it on a long approach, but not so minimal it skips useful structure. The internal frame keeps the load organized against your back.
• Ripstop nylon shell — water-resistant, so a trail shower won't soak your kit. It is not waterproof. In sustained rain or a full submersion, use a pack liner or rain cover.

Built for trekking. Straightforward to load, carry, and maintain.

Stock levels from the last restock didn't last long. Same story here.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
